limitations: Some studies reviewed as abstracts or indexed primary-source passages only.

Failure modes are proposed test designs, not measured frontier-model failures.

sources.title: UCSF Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma MRI Dataset — AWS Registry
sources.notes: Controlled download; release contents require independent manifest verification.

sources.title: UCSF-PCNSL official tutorial repository
sources.notes: Processed derivatives; two image spaces; component masks and feature tables. Main branch is mutable and example S3 location differs from registry.

sources.title: UCSF Imaging Datasets — dataset 4
sources.notes: Counts and DOI supplied by companion acquisition audit; not independently reverified here. Hosted archive and release-preparation branch must not be assumed identical.

sources.title: Quantitative diffusion and perfusion MRI for non-invasive MYD88/CD79B genotype characterization and prognostic stratification in primary CNS lymphoma
sources.notes: Accepted early article; direct genotype comparator, not externally established clinical utility.

sources.title: P17.04 Radiomics analysis of primary central nervous system lymphoma (PCNSL) - A LOC network study
sources.notes: Reported absence of MYD88/CD79B location association does not exclude other imaging signal.

sources.title: Genomic landscape and molecular subtypes of primary central nervous system lymphoma
sources.notes: BMI subtype includes BTG1/MYD88/IRF4 combinations; not MRI-to-IRF4 validation.

sources.title: The genomic and transcriptional landscape of primary central nervous system lymphoma
sources.cohort_scope: CNS lymphomas; not all pure PCNSL
sources.notes: Separate PCNSL, secondary CNS involvement and EBV-related disease; distinguish mutation classes.

sources.title: MRI-based radiomics virtual biopsy for BCL6 in primary central nervous system lymphoma
sources.notes: Not BCL6 IHC or any sequence variant; external testing not established.

sources.title: MRI-based radiomics signatures for preoperative prediction of Ki-67 index in primary central nervous system lymphoma
sources.notes: Phenotypic endpoint; classification threshold and full nesting need full-text verification.

sources.title: Radiomic features define risk and are linked to DNA methylation attributes in primary CNS lymphoma
sources.endpoint: Radiomic survival risk and molecular associations
sources.notes: Prediction direction and adjusted versus unadjusted external associations matter; not named mutation inference.

sources.title: Multiparametric-MRI-Based Radiomics Model for Differentiating Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma From Glioblastoma: Development and Cross-Vendor Validation
sources.notes: Diagnosis and genotype endpoints cannot be interchanged.

sources.title: Consensus recommendations for MRI and PET imaging of primary central nervous system lymphoma: guideline statement from the International Primary CNS Lymphoma Collaborative Group (IPCG)
sources.notes: Acquisition and response comparability; modality-specific protocols and systemic staging context.

sources.title: Primary central nervous system lymphomas: EHA–ESMO Clinical Practice Guideline for diagnosis, treatment and follow-up
sources.notes: Biopsy, corticosteroid and pretreatment timing motivate research cohort rules; not a substitute for case adjudication.

sources.title: Standards and Guidelines for the Interpretation and Reporting of Sequence Variants in Cancer: A Joint Consensus Recommendation of the Association for Molecular Pathology, American Society of Clinical Oncology, and College of American Pathologists
sources.notes: Somatic clinical-significance tiers must not silently become germline pathogenicity labels or assay-negative status.

sources.title: The Image Biomarker Standardization Initiative: Standardized Quantitative Radiomics for High-Throughput Image-based Phenotyping
sources.notes: Computational feature definitions and reference values; processing agreement does not prove clinical validity.

sources.title: Machine learning algorithm validation with a limited sample size
sources.notes: Small-sample validation and selection procedures require scrutiny.

sources.title: Cross-validation failure: Small sample sizes lead to large error bars
sources.notes: Across-fold standard errors underestimate uncertainty; repeated splitting does not add patients.

sources.title: Checklist for Artificial Intelligence in Medical Imaging (CLAIM): 2024 Update
sources.notes: Reporting guidance; supports internal/external testing terminology and reproducibility, not a clinical validity score.

sources.title: TRIPOD+AI statement: updated guidance for reporting clinical prediction models that use regression or machine learning methods
sources.notes: Transparent prediction-model reporting; not a prescribed model-development algorithm.
